Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class PredictiveBubbleTransferZoneReleaseModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.PredictiveBubbleTransferZoneReleaseModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReleaseFlowModel
public final class PredictiveBubbleTransferZoneReleaseModel extends Object implements ReleaseFlowModel
Predictive vertical bubbly transfer-zone adapter for component-selective release screening.

The adapter starts from the bounded Zuber-Findlay/Harmathy drift-flux solution and predicts the gas-to-liquid relative velocity and bubble residence time from the resolved phase velocities. A conservative spherical-bubble proxy for the Sauter mean diameter is the largest diameter that satisfies the configured transfer-zone geometry, the physical opening, Eo <= 4, and We <= 3. The resulting diameter, velocity and residence time drive the existing Ranz-Marshall external-film correlation and component-conservative finite-rate release model. The hydrodynamic and component-transfer calculations are iterated to a checked fixed point.

This is an unqualified screening closure for exactly one gas and one supported liquid phase. It does not represent a population balance, breakup/coalescence kinetics, entrainment, annular flow, interfacial heat transfer, internal bubble resistance, Stefan flow, solid-bearing transport or experimental qualification.

    • PredictiveBubbleTransferZoneReleaseModel

      public PredictiveBubbleTransferZoneReleaseModel(double surfaceTensionNm, double transferZoneHydraulicDiameterM, double transferZoneVerticalLengthM, double continuousPhaseDynamicViscosityPaS, Map<String,Double> componentDiffusivitiesM2S, String parameterProvenance)
      Creates a predictive vertical bubbly transfer-zone adapter.
      Parameters:
      surfaceTensionNm - caller-declared gas/liquid interfacial tension in N/m
      transferZoneHydraulicDiameterM - transfer-zone hydraulic diameter in m
      transferZoneVerticalLengthM - vertical contact length from release plane in m
      continuousPhaseDynamicViscosityPaS - continuous-liquid dynamic viscosity in Pa s
      componentDiffusivitiesM2S - continuous-liquid diffusivity in m2/s for every fluid component
      parameterProvenance - nonempty source or calibration identity for supplied properties and geometry
